blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Surrey total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in East Newton fell from 134 in June to 120 in September, and 39 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 10.7% of Surrey’s 1,120 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in East Newton?
East Newton also had 132 condos and townhomes listed and 11 sold in September, against 120 houses listed. The East Newton condos and townhomes page has those figures.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in East Newton?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 120 houses listed in East Newton. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is East Newton a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in East Newton had a sales ratio of 6%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in East Newton from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 39 houses sold in East Newton over those 4 months, out of 351 in all of Surrey.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in East Newton?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
